# Anti-Rotting Medications
These medications combat rotting. Make sure to revive the patient the moment they are fresh enough to revive!
Formaldehyde prevents rotting from occurring and may even slowly freshen patients if the body is already preserved.
Opporozidone requires [textlink="Cryogenics" link="Cryogenics"] to function.
Genecide is a hard-to-make chemical that removes rot exceedingly effectively but at the cost of causing the patient to repeatedly explode. Keep them away from anything important.
